description: Luxury-grade advanced data panels for the event, dj and local CPTs — one high-priority tabbed metabox per CPT, 1:1 with the Apollo add-new form design system.

meta.note: Owns no meta — it is an INPUT SURFACE writing meta owned by apollo-events / apollo-djs / apollo-loc.

canvas_contract.ref: admin metabox surface — emits no <body>, no canvas involvement

$provenance: Added 2026-07-28 — real plugin on disk that the registry never recorded.

$field_parity_2026_07_28.reason: These 5 fields existed only in the now-retired apollo-djs Admin\Metabox; added to DjPanel's Identidade card so lux-panels has 100% field parity before that metabox was disabled.

$new_field_type.name: repeater_card
$new_field_type.purpose: Repeater whose row is a mini-card of many sub-fields (vs. render_repeater()'s single flat-column row) — needed once a schema outgrows ~5 columns, e.g. _dj_tracks v2 (14 fields/row). Reuses the same .field/.apollo-input/.cover-upload primitives as every other field type — no new visual language.

opts_contract.sanitize_callback: optional callable(array $rows): array, run on the assembled rows before update_post_meta() — lets the owning plugin enforce its own validation (e.g. apollo_dj_sanitize_tracks_meta) in one place.
